messages.app.subtitle: Analysis of the interactions between the developers of a GitHub repository
messages.repository.name: Name
messages.data.status_empty: No data in memory for this repository: generate a graph to download it from GitHub, or load a previously saved file.
messages.token.memory_hint: The token is kept in memory only while the app is open.
messages.git.hint: With Git, commits are read from a temporary local clone instead of the API: essential for large repositories.
messages.git.found: ✓ Git {version} found · commits read from the local clone, almost no API requests
messages.git.not_found: ✕ Git not found · each commit costs 1 API request
messages.graph.collaboration.title: Collaboration graph
messages.graph.collaboration.description: Connects developers who modified the same files. The weight is the number of files they have in common.
messages.graph.communication.title: Communication graph
messages.graph.communication.description: Directed graph: an edge A → B means that A replied to B in issues, pull requests, reviews or comments.
messages.graph.composite.title: Composite graph
messages.graph.composite.description: Overlays the two graphs: blue for collaborations, red for communications, purple for pairs present in both.
messages.graph.empty_interval: No interactions in the selected interval
messages.graph.large_note: Large graph: labels only for the {count} most connected nodes
messages.graph.large_hover: hover over a node to see its name
messages.legend.title: Link types
messages.image.title: {repo} · {graph} · from {start} to {end}
messages.empty.title: No graph to show
messages.empty.hint:
Enter the owner and name of a repository, choose the graph type and the interval,
then press «Generate graph».
messages.validate.missing.title: Missing data
messages.validate.missing.text: Enter the owner and name of the repository.
messages.validate.dates.title: Invalid selection
messages.validate.dates.text: The start date must be earlier than or equal to the end date.
messages.validate.no_git.title: Git not found
messages.validate.no_git.text:
Git is not installed (or not in the PATH): commits will be downloaded through the API, with 1 request per commit, and for large repositories the hourly quota may not be enough.

To use the local clone, install Git and press «Check again».

Continue anyway?
messages.validate.no_token.title: No token
messages.validate.no_token.text:
Without a token the limit is 60 requests/hour, not enough for large repositories.

Continue anyway?
messages.validate.invalid_token.title: Invalid token
messages.validate.invalid_token.text: GitHub rejected the token. Check that it is correct and not expired.
messages.status.redownload: The selected interval is not covered by the data in memory: new download.
messages.status.rate_limited: API limit reached: the download resumes at {time}
messages.status.download_cancelled: Download cancelled: the parts already fully downloaded stay in memory
messages.error.title: Error
messages.error.rate_headers: Rate limit headers missing from the GitHub response
messages.file_error.not_graphapp: Invalid file: it does not contain GraphApp data.
messages.file_error.not_graphapp_detail: Invalid file: it does not contain GraphApp data ({error}).
messages.file_error.empty: Invalid file: it contains neither collaborations nor communications.
